slice: restricted core event tools with an explicitly declared single tool round-trip
purpose: Mount restricted, read-only event tools into the approved core decision session under a newly declared bounded tool policy: no factory keeps the historical H1 zero-tool/single-request path; with a factory at most one event tool call and two main requests/streams, with accounting that never fabricates zero/tool counts or usage.

implementation.tools: createCoreEventTools adds three tools: shiyu_core_event_types (discovery with schema/scope/canPublish/canSubscribe), shiyu_core_event_subscriptions (read-only own subscriptions and recent deliveries), shiyu_core_event_report (only agent.observation.reported). Actor/scope/source trust/allowed types come from the host-injected principal; arguments may not carry actor/permit/scope/taskId/ownerId; task.succeeded, component-only and publisherIds facts are rejected; receipts explicitly state they do not mean completion/verification/authorization/accounting/delivery.
implementation.decision: CoreDecisionRun declares the new boundary: without a factory the H1 historical single request/stream zero-tool path is byte-identical; with a factory at most one event tool call and at most two main requests/streams: request1 -> exactly one tool call -> matching tool/result (callId/name/raw arguments/native message hash checked) -> request2 -> one final text candidate. request2 maxTokens = maxTokens - first assistant output tokens; missing first usage/outputTokens is rejected as unknown, never guessed. Duplicate tool calls, a second tool round, missing results, unauthorized arguments, pause/revocation fail explicitly; tool results stay in the model context and never become Task/Goal facts or authorization.
implementation.accounting: new observable counters (mainModelRequests/mainModelStreams/toolCalls/toolResults/eventToolCalls/toolNames); modelCalls is non-null only on complete coverage, otherwise null; usage is reported only when every main call has complete usage, otherwise complete=false without fabricated tokens; persistent core.recordAccounting.calls remains the main-model call count and tool counts are encoded in evidenceRef, so the control contract is unchanged.
implementation.probe: goals.ts accepts a trusted CoreDecisionEventToolFactory, mounts it in the core compose, and adds probeCoreDecisionEventTools (dedicated shiyu-core-probe-* Session through the same restricted assembly path, no followup/model/Goal command, authority-field scan, explicit release/cleanup failures); local-core exposes eventTools, a deterministic prompt note, summarizeCoreDecisionAccounting and probeCoreEventTools with session.probe admission semantics.
